  friction  0.72

  friction  0.72
  bounce    dead

  is a      sphere 10 cm across, 0.20 kg
  moves     freely
  rolls
  friction  0.72
  bounce    dead
  centred over ring1, 30 cm above ring1

expect
  ball1 drops through ring1
  ball1 touches lever1
